effect.fr: Ouvre une chambre verrouillée dans l'Hôtel Grand Lac.
effect.en: Opens a locked building in the Lakeside Resort.

flavor.en: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
flavor.ko: 호수 근처에 있는 고급 호텔의 룸 키. 왜인지는 모르나 잘 없어진다.
flavor.ja: 湖の ほとりにある 高級ホテルの ルームキー。 なぜか よく なくなってしまう。
